answer: Random peer-review audit stops fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks five peers to mirror-check one record: costs, history, output. Like light through a prism, no clean field hides a fake. Flagging a fake pays a bounty; rubber-stamping one forfeits a deposit. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 audits: 5% catch, $40 each, loss $2,000 vs $300 rewards. Honest agents pay once, pass once, keep undiluted rewards as the tide of audits washes fakes out.
